# trufo_ai_system (Resource)

A registered Trufo **AI system** (`POST /ai-system/add`), referenced by `ai_system_id` when signing and watermarking. Registration details are immutable after creation — register each new version as a new AI system. Deleting this resource sets the AI system `inactive` (there is no delete endpoint). Note: the AI system endpoints are served by the production hosts only, and need a `c2pa-sign-*`/`watermark-*` scoped API key or a Bearer token with the `c2pa_sign` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# AI systems are registered on the production hosts with a c2pa-sign-* or
# watermark-* scoped API key (or a Bearer token with the c2pa_sign permission).
resource "trufo_ai_system" "image_gen" {
  name                   = "acme-image-gen"
  version                = "2.1.0"
  ai_involvement_modes   = ["ai_generated"]
  c2pa_first_party_attestable = true # requires the Created Assertion Acknowledgement
  nickname               = "Image Gen v2"
  status                 = "active"

  c2pa_ai_disclosure = {
    modelType       = "c2pa.types.model"
    modelName       = "acme-image-gen-2.1"
    contentProfile  = { humanOversightLevel = "prompt_guided" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ai_involvement_modes` (List of String) Which of `ai_generated` and `ai_modified` the AI system supports (one or both). Changing this forces recreation.
- `name` (String) The AI system's name; with `version`, its C2PA `softwareAgent`. Changing this forces recreation.
- `version` (String) The AI system's version; a new version is a new registration. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `c2pa_ai_disclosure` (Dynamic) A `c2pa.ai-disclosure` body (C2PA 2.4 § 18.28) describing the underlying model, as a dynamic value. Changing this forces recreation.
- `c2pa_first_party_attestable` (Boolean) Whether the organization operates the AI system and is accountable for its AI labels. Requires the Created Assertion Acknowledgement (accepted in the dashboard). Default: `false`. Changing this forces recreation.
- `nickname` (String) Display label only. Changing this forces recreation.
- `status` (String) `active` or `inactive`. `inactive` rejects new signs and embeds that use the AI system. Default: `active`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) AI system ID (`aisys_…`).
